DI_ce_shared_skill_target_min = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { step }
    is_valid = {
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = DI_ce_shared_skill_target } var:DI_ce_shared_skill_target > 0 }
        trigger_else = { always = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        set_variable = { name = DI_ce_shared_skill_target value = 0 }
    }
}

DI_ce_shared_diplomacy_set = {
    scope = character
    effect = {
        save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_ce_skill_selected_target value = DI_ce_shared_skill_target_value }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_owned_story = {
                    story_type = DI_misc_variables_story
                    has_variable = DI_pinned_char_var
                }
            }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = pinned_characters
                limit = { is_alive = yes }
                hidden_effect = {
                    add_diplomacy_skill = { value = scope:DI_ce_skill_selected_target subtract = diplomacy }
                    force_character_skill_recalculation = yes
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            if = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes }
                hidden_effect = {
                    add_diplomacy_skill = { value = scope:DI_ce_skill_selected_target subtract = diplomacy }
                    force_character_skill_recalculation = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_ce_shared_diplomacy_set_character = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { recipient }
    is_valid = { exists = scope:recipient scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes } }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes } }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = DI_ce_skill_selected_target value = DI_ce_shared_skill_target_value }
            scope:recipient = {
                hidden_effect = {
                    add_diplomacy_skill = { value = scope:DI_ce_skill_selected_target subtract = diplomacy }
                    force_character_skill_recalculation = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
